lines: You aren't trying to impress everyone.
You just forget how to say no.
That wears you out and hides you.
Your brain plugs the silence with what they want.
Because you never draw a line, they think you’ll always say yes.
Try saying a single no and notice the space.
Finally, you’ll feel lighter than before.
Follow for more daily psychology about people and relationships.
